_meta.description: Canonical navigation layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (ADR-037). Fragments stay the source of WHAT exists in the menu; this file is the single place deciding WHERE entries live. relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId. removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired as duplicate navigation — their PAGES stay routable for deep links. settingsSection: leaf ids lifted into the NC gear foldout (NcAppNavigationSettings, outside the scrollable nav) — config/admin/app-registration entries only; operational/vault/activity items stay in the main nav.
